map.注意力头维度是做什么的？: What does Attention Head Dimension do?
map.如何使用注意力头维度？: How do I use Attention Head Dimension?
map.注意力头维度适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Attention Head Dimension best for?
map.每头维度 = d / heads；单层权重参数 ≈ 4d² + 2d·ffn: Dimension per head = d / heads; single-layer weight parameters ~ 4d² + 2d·ffn
map.多头注意力把 d 维切成 heads 份并行计算，每头维度须整除，头数过多会让单: Multi-head attention splits the d dimension into heads for parallel computation; the per-head dimension must divide evenly, and too many heads make each head too small and weaken expressiveness. The single-layer parameters come from the four attention matrices (4d²) and the two FFN layers (2d·ffn), which dominate memory and compute.
map.常见 head_dim 64，过大或过小均影响表达。: A common head_dim is 64; too large or too small hurts expressiveness.
map.每头维度 d_head=d_model/h，需整除；常见 d_model=512: Per-head dimension d_head = d_model / h, must divide evenly; common d_model=512, h=8 -> d_head=64.
map.单层注意力参数量≈4·d_model²（Q/K/V/O 四个投影），与头数无关只: Single-layer attention parameters ~ 4·d_model² (the Q/K/V/O projections), independent of head count and only tied to total dimension.
map.头数过多而 d_head 过小会限制每头表达能力，需权衡并行度与单头容量。: Too many heads with too small d_head limits each head’s capacity; balance parallelism against per-head capacity.
map.d_model=768, h=12 → d_head=64。Q/K/V/O 各: d_model=768, h=12 -> d_head=64. Each of Q/K/V/O is 768x768 ~ 590k params, single-layer attention ~ 4x590k = 2.36M params; independent of h, only depends on d_model.
map.不一定。头数增加提升并行关注不同子空间的能力，但 d_head 随之变小、每头容: Not necessarily. More heads improve the ability to attend to different subspaces in parallel, but d_head shrinks and per-head capacity is limited; excessive heads yield diminishing returns and more compute.
map.d_head 不整除怎么办？: What if d_head does not divide evenly?
map.需调整 d_model 或头数使其整除，否则框架会报错或 padding 引入冗: Adjust d_model or head count so it divides evenly, otherwise the framework errors or padding adds redundancy; common configs ensure d_model % h == 0.
